1197-98a. τεύξεσθαι ἐνηέος Αἰήταο: For they did not suppose that they would be received kindly and gently by Aeetes, because they were companions of Jason. L
b. τεύξασθαι: to meet with. LgP
5 Schaefer noted that this interpreter read τεύξασθαι; cf. W 56
1199. Ἄργος ἀτεμβόμενος: not in the Homeric sense of "being deprived"; for here it is used of being vexed and blaming them for undertaking such an expedition.

1209-15a. Καυκάσου ἐν κνη〈μοῖσι〉: On the Caucasus, he says, on the Typhonian rock, Typhon, struck by lightning, emitted certain ichors, from which came the serpent that guards the fleece. That Typhon fled to the Caucasus when pursued, and that when the mountain was burning he fled from there to Italy, where the island of Pithecussa was thrown around him, Pherecydes in his Theogony (3 fg 54 J.) relates, but not that he was also driven to the regions around Syria, as Apollonius says.
15 Strab. V 248. XIII 626 sch. Pind. Pyth. I 34a Steph. Byz. Ἄριμα
12 φησίν W : φασίν ἰχῶρα in Gg

b. ἔνθα Τυφάονα: This one, he says, struck by Zeus, went as he was to the regions around Syria and Pelusium, pursued [by Zeus], where he sank and lies in the Serbonian lake. This lake extends from Syria to Pelusium. That Typhon lies in it is also related by Herodorus (31 fg 61 J.).

18 Et. Gen. (AB) Τυφάονα καὶ Τυφαονία πέτρα: as in II 1210. κνημὸς is called a rough and hard place. Τυφαονίῃ ὑπὸ πέτρῃ: one must know that Ποσειδῶν, when divided as Ποσειδάωνος, preserves the ω, but Τυφῶν, Τυφάων, Τυφάονος shortens it. The Typhonian rock is a high rock in the Caucasus, and the Caucasus is a mountain of Scythia and another of India. It is named because Typhon, pursued by Zeus, was struck by lightning on it. They say that after being struck he went away burning in the Serbonian lake—the Serbonian lake is in Egypt near Pelusium—and fell into its depth and sank, overcome by the burning. The lake is between Arabia and Egypt and sends up a certain heat from Typhon burning in it.
18 ὡς εἶχεν (cf. αὔτως ν. 1213) 〈εἰς τοὺς〉 F : οὓς εἶχε in L : 〈εἰς〉 οὓς εἶχε K : om. in P
